title: Taming Momentum: Rethinking Optimizer States Through Low-Rank Approximation

layout.note: One beige dashed frame under a headline. Two mirrored halves joined by a large central block arrow: left half stacks EMA formula, equivalence arrow, loss, matrix box on a gradient stream and update rule; right half repeats the same rows with two factors and their updates.
